assumptions.choice: Manually aggregate 5-minute bars into 30-minute candles inside next() using the absolute bar index (len(self.data)) rather than cerebro.resampledata/replaydata
assumptions.reason: The harness fixes a single 5-minute PandasData feed added by its own cerebro setup; the strategy has no access to cerebro to add a resampled second feed, so the 30-minute aggregation described in the spec is reproduced arithmetically from the 5-minute series instead.

assumptions.choice: 30-minute group boundaries are computed from the absolute feed bar index (len(self.data)-1) modulo 6, not a counter that starts at the first next() call
assumptions.reason: Backtrader delays next() until indicator minperiod (slow SMA=40) is satisfied; anchoring to the absolute bar index keeps 30-minute groups aligned to the 09:30 session start (4680 bars = 60 days x 78 bars/day, evenly divisible by 6) despite the warm-up delay.

assumptions.choice: MACD(12,26,9) is instantiated as required by the 'Indicators' section but is not referenced in the entry/exit logic
assumptions.reason: The spec's 'Signal generation logic' section defines the entry filter using only ma_crosses and avg_rsi; no MACD condition is stated, and the instructions forbid inventing additional filters.

assumptions.choice: Size computed manually as int(available_cash / current_close) at signal time and passed to self.buy(size=...)
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly requires 100% of capital per trade (not silent), but the strategy has no access to cerebro to add a PercentSizer, so the equivalent full-cash share count is computed directly.

assumptions.choice: SL/TP thresholds are checked against the 5-minute bar close price on every bar while a position is open
assumptions.reason: Spec states percentage thresholds off entry price without specifying which price series to monitor intrabar; close price is the simplest literal reading given only OHLCV bars are available.

assumptions.choice: Implemented the strategy logic against the single fixed AAPL 5-minute feed only; the 30-50 ticker S&P 500 universe and multi-year historical backtest described under 'Additional rules' are not implemented
assumptions.reason: The execution environment fixes one AAPL data feed for one date range; multi-ticker scanning and alternate history periods require data/assets outside what the harness provides.

assumptions.choice: Entry/exit orders are submitted with plain self.buy()/self.close() at the bar where the condition is detected and fill per backtrader's default next-bar-open behavior
assumptions.reason: Spec does not specify order execution timing, so the environment's default broker fill semantics are used unmodified.
